2026-09-23.patch_summary: This patch removes the deprecated Kconfig option CONFIG_NFSD_LEGACY_CLIENT_TRACKING, which enabled legacy client tracking methods for NFSv4 servers. The last remaining legacy method, on-disk recoverydir, is also removed along with related files and tracepoints. This change aligns with modern deployments that use nfsdcld for state recovery after reboot, making the codebase more streamlined and easier to maintain.
